# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 53 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_053_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 53

**1** His disciples said to him: "Is circumcision [свве] beneficial [нфеле] or not?"

**2** He said to them: "If it were beneficial, their father would have had them born with it from their mother. But the true [меме] circumcision in spirit [пна] has found complete usefulness."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *свве*: circumcision
- *нфеле*: to be useful, beneficial
- "Born already circumcised" — the argument: if God wanted circumcision, children would be born with it
- *меме*: true, real, genuine
- "Circumcision in spirit" — the spiritual circumcision; the inner transformation
- cf. Rom 2:28-29: "A Jew is not one outwardly... circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit"
- cf. Col 2:11: "A circumcision made without hands... the circumcision of Christ"
- Thomas's position: physical circumcision is useless; spiritual circumcision is the true form
